method: Popen(--port 4499), wait for the port, terminate() then wait(10); reference: kill()
sideEffectObserved: after the SIGKILL reference trial, the WebKitWebDriver child spawned by tauri-driver stayed alive (ppid 1, listening on 4445) for about 8 minutes until this session terminated that one PID (verified by start time and environment). A forced kill can leave the driver chain behind.
policy: strict D1 accepts driverKilled False with driverExit 0 (observed) or -SIGTERM (subprocess report for default SIGTERM disposition; INFERRED, not observed for this binary); any forced kill or other status fails
